{{Quote|My sources at Getelles’s court tell me Loronar is pretty much backing Getelles’s whole household. The local CEO, Dymurra, lives there like a king: sex droids, vibrobaths, plug-ins, glitterstim, four different chefs, self-conforming slippers, independently controlled environments in every room of his mansion, you name it.|Yarbolk Yemm|<ref name="Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Sex droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Twilight" /> By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> sources within [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]]'s [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] informed [[Yarbolk Yemm]], [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] for [[TriNebulon News/Legends|''TriNebulon News'']], that the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] for [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]], [[Gnifmak Dymurra]], lived a life fit for a [[King/Legends|king]] on<ref name="Twilight" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Antemeridias system/Legends|Antemeridias system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|34|Antemeridias}}</ref> [[Antemeridias]]. Sex droids were used as an example of Dymurra's lavish lifestyle.<ref name="Twilight" /> In 13 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Yemm shared that information with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Twilight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sex droids were mentioned in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a [[1997]] novel written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="Twilight" />
